name: CSGOPremier Inventory Value
description: Adds a "Get my inventory value" button to the CSGOPremier inventory page, shows the price change on "Sell to Market", adds "Price" and "Float" sort options, a "Sellable" tab, match and lobby-invite auto-accept, opening several cases at once, a cart for buying several cases and capsules at once, float/pattern badges (inventory and market), float/price filters and market pattern and rare-item filters, a price sort on the Trade-Up page, match details above the clip on the Overwatch review page, a compact match scoreboard with country flags, with the same scoreboard for live matches, a "Join game" button that starts CS:GO and joins the match server, with auto-join when the join timer reaches a set time, and the Season Pass reward track opening on your current level.
